positive_snippets:
I have not visited this place but for the standard created by the shree ji group, i have given 4 stars ✨.

In Najafgarh they have best stylish party 🥳  hall and banquet with good 👍 food. Thinking of the same facilities and according to viewing insides pics of hotel online i know this is as per expectations.

I have visited their Najafgarh shri ji banquet and ordered food from their many times , everything awesome 👌.

This is situated on delhi-Bhadurgarh border near jharoda border on haryana side.

Location is good as from here you can easily reach Najafgarh, bhadurgarh, Mundka, tikri border and even rohtak.

I am recommending this as i know the standard of bhadurgarh hotels 🏨 except one or two all other are below average and mainly using rooms on other means for their bread and butter.  😃😄😁

Happy Staying 😊
The rooms are cozy, new and clean. Reasonable price with clean room. Hotel under Rs 2000.
Nice food and good rooms.. Couples and family can have good stay there.
